name: Divine Conception ~I Found a Magic Book, and Now I'm Impregnating Angels and Demons?!~
source:
In Divine Conception you play the role of Kazuma, an ordinary Japanese guy who suddenly finds himself living with two beautiful girls straight out of a fantasy book: Aliyah a powerful and alluring succubus, and Gabrielle, a kind and innocent angel. Rivalry between them will ensue as they fight for one thing and one thing only: Kazuma's seed.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/haramaseproject]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在《神圣构想》中，你扮演Kazuma的角色，一个普通的日本男人，突然发现自己和两个美丽的女孩住在一起，这两个女孩完全是从奇幻书中走出来的：Aliyah是一个强大而迷人的魅魔，而Gabrielle是一个善良而天真的天使。他们之间的竞争将会随之而来，因为他们只为一件事而战：和真的种子。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/haramaseproject]Patreon[/url]]
